👮 **Wachiman** · review of the whole pull request, at `e45c845`: all 31 files reviewed.

3 finding(s): 3 to consider; 3 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Summary

**Batch 1 of 2.** Part 1 looks sound overall; I found two non-blocking issues. First, the Library's new Ready to upload card does not mark the copy seen when the user clicks Show in Finder or drags the file out. The export toast does this for the same actions, and `ready-copies.ts` documents it. As a result, the "1 copy ready" chip and the outline stay on the copy after the user has already acted on it. Second, the test "opening the copy goes to its page and forgets it" never checks that the copy was forgotten. The other changes match their contracts as far as I read them: the fingerprint fix in `copy-destination.ts`, the session-wide minimized widget, and retiring the cards when the user leaves the Library through the sidebar's route watch.

**Batch 2 of 2.** I reviewed the 4 stylesheets, the 3 backlog docs and both message catalogs in this part. The new and changed i18n keys match how the components use them. The removed keys `hide` and `readyDragToUpload` have no callers left. Every ICU `select` handles the `export` value through its `other` branch, and the archive destination tag also comes from `other`. The CSS variables these files use are defined in `@kaipu/tokens` or `base.css`. The two-column span fits the Library's fixed 3-column grid. The new backlog doc's claims match the code: the minimized state is per session in sessionStorage, the sidebar's route watch retires the cards, `copyDestinationOf` compares only the part before `#`, and an error always shows in full. One finding: the update note added to `background-copy-toasts.md` doesn't mention that this PR renamed the card text. That doc is still waiting for owner QA, and its \"What the user sees\" section and validation steps still quote the old strings.

<details><summary>What the change connects to (7 closed, 0 open)</summary>

Questions the reviewer answered about what this change does to the running product. The engine checked that the cited lines exist, not that the answers are true.

**Closed, with the lines they rest on**
- Show in Finder on the Library's Ready to upload card (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/components/ready-copy-card.tsx:80`) — Finder opens on the file. The card, chip and outline stay because the copy is not marked seen. If it fails: The IPC promise is voided, as in the sibling and use-local-library.ts:98, so a rejection is silent and nothing in the UI changes. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.tsx:280`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/ready-copies.ts:10-11`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/components/ready-copy-card.tsx:80`.
- Native drag of the copy from the Library ready card (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/components/ready-copy-card.tsx:90-94`) — Main starts the native file drag. The browser's default drag is prevented. If it fails: startFileDrag is a fire-and-forget send, so a failure is silent, the same as the sibling. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.tsx:290-295`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/components/ready-copy-card.tsx:90-94`.
- Open or dismiss a ready card (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library/library-page.tsx:415-419`) — Open goes to the detail page. Dismiss brings back the regular card, outlined. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/ready-copies.ts:76-91`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:96-104`.
- Retire the ready cards when the route leaves the Library (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:99-103`) — The next visit to the Library shows the plain grid. A copy that finishes later gets its own card. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/app-shell.tsx:49`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/ready-copies.ts:97-100`.
- Minimize the export widget, or expand it from the pill (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-widget-state.ts:25-35`) — The card is replaced by the pill with a ring and percent. Clicking the pill restores the card. If it fails: sessionStorage errors are caught, and the choice holds in memory. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.tsx:40-50`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-widget-state.ts:10-16`.
- Minimize the export widget to a fixed bottom-right pill with a progress ring; clicking the pill expands it again (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.module.css:76`) — The pill sits inside `.exportStack`, a fixed container at the bottom right, 40px from the bottom so it clears the 28px status bar. The container has pointer-events: none; the pill sets pointer-events: auto, so only the pill takes clicks. If it fails: If sessionStorage throws, the read falls back to expanded and the write is skipped, so the choice still holds in memory. Because the flag lasts for the session, every later export also opens as the p… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.tsx:40-52`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.tsx:152-154`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.tsx:199-204`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-widget-state.ts:10-35`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/status-stack.module.css:19-28`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.module.css:76-78`.
- Show a two-column "Ready to upload" card at the start of the Library grid, with a destination tag and the ✕, Show in Finder and Drag actions (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/components/ready-copy-card.module.css:2`) — The Library grid always has 3 columns, so `grid-column: span 2` never forces an implicit extra column. The tag colours match `destination-logo.module.css`. An archive copy gets the default dark tag and the "Archive copy" text from the `other` branch of the message. If it fails: No new async work in these files. The card state lives in memory, so it is lost on relaunch, as documented. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library/library-page.module.css:366-371`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/ready-copies.ts:87-105`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:96-104`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/components/destination-logo.module.css:11-28`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/destinations.ts:36-43`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/components/ready-copy-card.tsx:49-110`.
